title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三: 世祖
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三: 世祖 Volume 3: Emperor Wen

sentences.zh: 陳書卷三

translations.literal: Book of Chen, Volume 3
translations.idiomatic: Book of Chen, Volume 3

sentences.zh: 本紀第三

translations.literal: Basic Annals, Number Three
translations.idiomatic: Annals, Part Three

sentences.zh: 世祖文皇帝諱蒨，字子華，始興昭烈王長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen the Shizu, taboo name Qian, style Zihua, was the eldest son of Prince Zhao-lie of Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen the Shizu, whose personal name was tabooed as Qian and who styled himself Zihua, was the eldest son of Prince Zhao-lie of Shixing.

sentences.zh: 少沈敏有識量，美容儀，留意經史，舉動方雅，造次必遵禮法。

translations.literal: In youth he was deep, keen, and possessed of discernment; handsome in bearing; devoted to the classics and histories; his conduct square and elegant; in every action he unfailingly observed ritual law.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was thoughtful, sharp, and far-seeing, with a handsome presence. He steeped himself in the classics and histories, moved with measured grace, and never acted without regard for ritual.

sentences.zh: 高祖甚愛之，常稱「 此兒吾宗之英秀也」。

translations.literal: The Founder loved him greatly and often said, "This boy is the outstanding talent of our clan."
translations.idiomatic: The Founder adored him and would say, "This son is the finest of our house."

sentences.zh: 梁太清初，夢兩日鬥，一大一小，大者光滅墜地，色正黃，其大如斗，世祖因三分取一而懷之。

translations.literal: Early in the Taichu era of Liang he dreamed that two suns fought, one large and one small; the larger sun's light went out and fell to earth, yellow in color, as large as the Dipper; Emperor Wen therefore took one third of it and held it in his bosom.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Liang's Taichu era he dreamed of two suns at war, one great and one small. The greater sun's light died and fell to earth, yellow and as wide as the Big Dipper; Emperor Wen took a third of it into his breast.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，鄉人多依山湖寇抄，世祖獨保家無所犯。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion many of his townspeople relied on mountain-and-lake bandits for pillaging; Emperor Wen alone protected his household, and it was never violated.
translations.idiomatic: During Hou Jing's rebellion many neighbors turned to mountain and lake brigands for plunder, but Emperor Wen alone kept his household safe and untouched.

sentences.zh: 時亂日甚，乃避地臨安。

translations.literal: As disorder grew daily, he fled to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: As chaos deepened day by day, he took refuge at Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 及高祖舉義兵，侯景遣使收世祖及衡陽獻王，世祖乃密袖小刀，冀因入見而害景，至便屬吏，故其事不行。

translations.literal: When the Founder raised the righteous army, Hou Jing sent messengers to seize Emperor Wen and the Prince Xian of Hengyang; Emperor Wen secretly hid a small knife in his sleeve, hoping to kill Jing when he entered audience; when he arrived he was handed to the officials, and so the plan failed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founder raised the righteous army, Hou Jing sent men to seize Emperor Wen and the Prince Xian of Hengyang. Emperor Wen hid a small knife in his sleeve, intending to kill Jing at audience; but on arrival he was turned over to the clerks, and the plot came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 高祖大軍圍石頭，景欲加害者數矣，會景敗，世祖乃得出赴高祖營。

translations.literal: The Founder's great army besieged Stone Fortress; Jing several times wished to harm him; when Jing was defeated, Emperor Wen was able to come out and join the Founder's camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder's main force besieged Stone Fortress. Hou Jing more than once meant to kill him; when Jing fell, Emperor Wen at last escaped to the Founder's camp.

sentences.zh: 起家為吳興太守。

translations.literal: He began his career as Administrator of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as administrator of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 時宣城劫帥紀機、郝仲等各聚眾千餘人，侵暴郡境，世祖討平之。

translations.literal: At the time the bandit chiefs Ji Ji and Hao Zhong and others each gathered over a thousand men and ravaged the commandery borders; Emperor Wen subdued them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit leaders Ji Ji, Hao Zhong, and others had each raised more than a thousand men and were ravaging the commandery; Emperor Wen defeated and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 承聖二年，授信武將軍，監南徐州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chengsheng he was appointed Trustworthy Martial General and overseer of South Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chengsheng (552) he was made Trustworthy Martial General and put in charge of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，高祖北征廣陵，使世祖為前軍，每戰克捷。

translations.literal: In the third year the Founder campaigned north to Guangling and made Emperor Wen vanguard; in every battle he was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Founder marched north against Guangling with Emperor Wen as vanguard; battle after battle went his way.

sentences.zh: 高祖之將討王僧辯也，先召世祖與謀。

translations.literal: When the Founder was about to attack Wang Sengbian, he first summoned Emperor Wen to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Before moving against Wang Sengbian, the Founder called Emperor Wen in to counsel with him.

sentences.zh: 時僧辯女婿杜龕據吳興，兵眾甚盛，高祖密令世祖還長城，立柵以備龕。

translations.literal: Sengbian's son-in-law Du Kan held Wuxing with very strong forces; the Founder secretly ordered Emperor Wen back to Changcheng to build palisades against Kan.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian's son-in-law Du Kan held Wuxing with a formidable host; the Founder secretly ordered Emperor Wen back to Changcheng to throw up palisades against him.

sentences.zh: 世祖收兵纔數百人，戰備又少，龕遣其將杜泰領精兵五千，乘虛奄至，將士相視失色，而世祖言笑自若，部分益明，於是眾心乃定。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen had gathered only a few hundred troops and had little military gear; Kan sent his general Du Tai with five thousand elite troops, taking advantage to arrive suddenly; the officers stared at one another pale, but Emperor Wen spoke and laughed as usual, his dispositions clearer still, and so hearts were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen had barely a few hundred men and scant stores of arms. Kan sent his general Du Tai with five thousand picked troops to strike while the camp was weak. The officers turned pale, but Emperor Wen jested as before, gave his orders with greater clarity, and steadied them.

sentences.zh: 泰知柵內人少，日夜苦攻，世祖激厲將士，身當矢石，相持數旬，泰乃退走。

translations.literal: Tai knew few were inside the palisade and attacked bitterly day and night; Emperor Wen roused the troops, took arrows and stones upon himself, held for several tens of days, and Tai then retreated.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing how few defenders the palisade held, Tai pressed the assault day and night. Emperor Wen heartened his men, stood in the line of missile fire himself, and held for many weeks until Tai withdrew.

sentences.zh: 及高祖遣周文育率兵討龕，世祖與并軍往吳興。

translations.literal: When the Founder sent Zhou Wenyü with troops against Kan, Emperor Wen joined the army and went to Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founder dispatched Zhou Wenyü against Du Kan, Emperor Wen marched with him to Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 時龕兵尚眾，斷據衝要，水步連陣相結，世祖命將軍劉澄、蔣元舉率眾攻龕，龕軍大敗，窘急，因請降。

translations.literal: Kan's troops were still numerous, blocking the strategic passes; water and land columns were linked in formation; Emperor Wen ordered the generals Liu Cheng and Jiang Yuanju to lead the attack; Kan's army was greatly defeated, in dire straits, and sued for surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Kan still fielded a large force, holding the crossings; his fleets and columns were chained together. Emperor Wen sent Liu Cheng and Jiang Yuanju against him. Kan's army was shattered, driven to extremity, and begged to surrender.

sentences.zh: 東揚州刺史張彪起兵圍臨海太守王懷振，懷振遣使求救，世祖與周文育輕兵往會稽以掩彪。

translations.literal: East Yangzhou Inspector Zhang Biao raised troops and besieged Linhai Administrator Wang Huai-zhen; Huai-zhen sent messengers begging rescue; Emperor Wen and Zhou Wenyü led light troops to Kuaiji to strike Biao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Biao, inspector of East Yangzhou, rebelled and besieged Wang Huai-zhen, administrator of Linhai. Huai-zhen sent for help; Emperor Wen and Zhou Wenyü took light forces to Kuaiji to fall upon Biao.

sentences.zh: 後彪將沈泰開門納世祖，世祖盡收其部曲家累，彪至，又破走，若邪村民斬彪，傳其首。

translations.literal: Later Biao's general Shen Tai opened the gate and admitted Emperor Wen; Emperor Wen took in all his following and their families; when Biao arrived he was again defeated and driven off; the villagers of Ruoye cut off Biao's head and sent it.
translations.idiomatic: Biao's officer Shen Tai then opened the gates to Emperor Wen, who seized his troops and dependants. When Biao came up he was beaten again and fled. The people of Ruoye slew him and sent his head.

sentences.zh: 以功授持節、都督會稽等十郡諸軍事、宣毅將軍、會稽太守。

translations.literal: For his merit he was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander of All Military Affairs over the Ten Commanderies of Kuaiji and Others, General Who Inspires Awe, and Administrator of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: For these deeds he received the staff of command, authority over military affairs in ten commanderies including Kuaiji, the title General Who Inspires Awe, and the post of administrator of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: [1]山越深險，皆不賓附，世祖分命討擊，悉平之，威惠大振。

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 1. The mountains grew ever deeper and more perilous, and none submitted; Emperor Wen divided his orders and attacked; all were pacified, and his authority and kindness greatly flourished.
translations.idiomatic: See editorial note 1. In the deep hills many still refused allegiance; Emperor Wen sent columns against them and brought all to order, until his authority and mercy were felt throughout the region.

sentences.zh: 高祖受禪，立為臨川郡王，邑二千戶，拜侍中、安東將軍。

translations.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Emperor Wen was enfeoffed as Prince of Linchuan with a fief of two thousand households and appointed Palace Attendant and General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founder took the throne, Emperor Wen was made Prince of Linchuan with a fief of two thousand households, palace attendant, and General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 及周文育、侯安都敗於沌口，高祖詔世祖入衛，軍儲戎備，皆以委焉。

translations.literal: When Zhou Wenyü and Hou Andu were defeated at Zhunkou, the Founder ordered Emperor Wen to enter the capital as guard; military stores and war preparations were all entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhou Wenyü and Hou Andu were beaten at Zhunkou, the Founder summoned Emperor Wen to defend the capital and placed all grain, arms, and war stores in his hands.

sentences.zh: 尋命率兵城南皖。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops south to Wan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to take an army south to Wan.

sentences.zh: 永定三年六月景午，高祖崩，遺詔徵世祖入纂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Yongding, on the day wuwu of the cycle, the Founder died; the testamentary edict summoned Emperor Wen to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of Yongding (559), on wuwu day, the Founder died; his final edict called Emperor Wen to the succession.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自南皖，入居中書省。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin he arrived from South Wan and entered the Directorate of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he returned from South Wan and took seat in the Directorate of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 皇后令曰：「昊天不弔，上玄降禍。

translations.literal: The Empress's order said: "High Heaven shows no pity; the Supreme Lord has sent down calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The empress issued an order: "Heaven shows no pity; the Supreme Lord has sent down calamity.

sentences.zh: 大行皇帝奄捐萬國，率土哀號，普天如喪，窮酷煩冤，無所迨及。

translations.literal: The late emperor has suddenly left the myriad states; all within the four seas wail; the whole realm is as in mourning; bitter grief and affliction admit of no escape.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor has suddenly left the realm; all under heaven wails as though the sky had fallen; grief beyond bearing has no end.

sentences.zh: 諸孤藐爾，反國無期，須立長主，以寧宇縣。

translations.literal: The several orphans are slight; there is no date for returning to the state; a chief lord must be established to settle the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The young princes are helpless and the realm has no master; a ruler must be set up to bring peace to the land.

sentences.zh: 侍中、安東將軍、臨川王蒨，體自景皇，屬惟猶子，建殊功於牧野，敷盛業於戡黎，納麓時敘之辰，負扆乘機之日，並佐時雍，是同草創，祧祏所繫，遐邇宅心，宜奉大宗，嗣膺寶錄，使七廟有奉，兆民寧晏。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, and Prince of Linchuan Qian—his person derives from the Founding Emperor; among the late emperor's sons he is the chosen heir; he raised extraordinary merit at Muye and spread great achievement in pacifying the people; at the time of receiving the chart at Lu, on the day of bearing the throne, he alike assisted the age's harmony and shared in the founding; the ancestral tablets and the far and near all rest their hearts on him. He should receive the great lineage and succeed to the precious record, that the seven temples may have sacrifice and the hundred millions find peace.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, Prince of Linchuan Qian—born of the imperial line, chosen among the late emperor's sons—won signal merit in the founding wars and spread his fame in pacifying the realm. At the receiving of the mandate and the taking of the throne he shared alike in creation of the dynasty. The altars of state and men far and near look to him. Let him receive the great succession and mount the throne, that the seven temples may be served and the people find rest.

sentences.zh: 未亡人假延餘息，嬰此百罹，尋繹纏綿，興言感絕。

translations.literal: The one not yet dead borrows lingering breath, bears these hundred afflictions, follows the tangled thread of grief, and speaks with feeling to the breaking point.
translations.idiomatic: I who am left borrow a little breath more, bear a hundred griefs, trace this tangled sorrow, and cannot speak without breaking.

sentences.zh: 」世祖固讓，至于再三，群公卿士固請，其日即皇帝位於太極前殿。

translations.literal: " Emperor Wen firmly declined, even to a third time; the dukes, ministers, and scholars firmly pressed him; that very day he ascended the imperial throne in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Wen refused firmly, again and again; the nobles and officials pressed him without relent; that same day he took the throne in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「上天降禍，奄集邦家，大行皇帝背離萬國，率土崩心，若喪考妣。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Heaven has sent down calamity and gathered upon the state; the late emperor has left the myriad states; all within the soil have hearts that break; it is as though one had lost father and mother.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Heaven has sent calamity upon the realm; the late emperor has left us; all the land is stricken as by the death of a parent.

sentences.zh: 龍圖寶曆，眇屬朕躬，運鍾擾攘，事切機務，南面須主，西讓禮輕，今便式膺景命，光宅四海。

translations.literal: The dragon chart and precious calendar are faintly placed upon Our person; the age's fortune meets disturbance; affairs press upon the pivot of power; the south must have a lord; western yielding makes ritual light; We now formally receive the bright mandate and brightly dwell in the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon chart and sacred calendar have fallen to Our person; the times are turbulent and the helm cannot wait; the realm needs a ruler, and modest refusal would slight the rites. We now take the bright mandate and rule the four seas.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，罪無輕重，悉皆蕩滌。

translations.literal: A great amnesty is proclaimed for all under heaven; crimes whether light or heavy are all washed away.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm; crimes light or heavy are all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 逋租宿債，吏民愆負，可勿復收。

translations.literal: Overdue rents and old debts, and offenses and debts of officials and people, shall not again be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears of tax and old debts, and penalties owed by officials and commoners, shall not be collected again.

sentences.zh: 文武內外，量加爵敘。

translations.literal: Civil and military, within and without, shall receive promotions of rank in due measure.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers at court and in the provinces shall be advanced in rank as their service warrants.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田為父後者，賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Those filial, dutiful, and diligent in farming who are heirs to their fathers shall be granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Men noted for filial piety and farming, who are heirs to their fathers, shall receive one step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 庶祗畏在心，公卿畢力，勝殘去殺，無待百年。

translations.literal: Let awe and respect dwell in every heart and the ministers give their full strength; to overcome cruelty and remove killing need not wait a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Let reverence fill every heart and the ministers give their all; to end cruelty and slaughter need not wait a century.

sentences.zh: 興言號哽，深增慟絕。

translations.literal: Speaking brings choked sobs and deep increase of grief to the breaking point.
translations.idiomatic: Even to speak of it chokes Us with grief beyond bearing.

sentences.zh: 」又詔州郡悉停奔赴。

translations.literal: " Another edict ordered all provinces and commanderies to halt envoys rushing to court.
translations.idiomatic: " A further edict ordered every province and commandery to stop dispatching envoys in haste to the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月景辰，尊皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, autumn, on the day chen of the cycle, the empress was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on chen day, the empress was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 己未，以鎮南將軍、開府儀同三司、廣州刺史歐陽頠進號征南將軍，平南將軍、開府儀同三司周迪進號鎮南將軍，[2]平南將軍、開府儀同三司、高州刺史黃法𣰋進號安南將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Pacifying South General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Guangzhou Ouyang Yi was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns South; Pacifying South General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes Zhou Di was advanced in title to General Who Guards the South; Editorial footnote marker 2. Pacifying South General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Gaozhou Huang Faqu was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Ouyang Yi, pacifying south general, grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Guangzhou, was promoted to general who campaigns south; Zhou Di, pacifying south general and grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, was promoted to general who guards the south; See editorial note 2. Huang Faqu, pacifying south general, grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Gaozhou, was promoted to general who pacifies the south.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以鎮南大將軍、開府儀同三司、桂州刺史淳于量進號征南大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Guarding South Grand General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Guizhou Chunyu Liang was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns South.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Chunyu Liang, guarding south grand general, grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Guizhou, was promoted to general who campaigns south.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以侍中、車騎將軍、司空侯瑱為太尉，鎮西將軍、開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史侯安都為司空，侍中、中權將軍、開府儀同三司王沖為特進、左光祿大夫，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史徐度為侍中、中撫軍將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Palace Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Minister of Works Hou Tian became Grand Mentor; Pacifying West General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of South Yuzhou Hou Andu became Minister of Works; Palace Attendant, Central Authority General, and Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes Wang Chong became Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace; Guarding North General, and Inspector of South Xuzhou Xu Du became Palace Attendant, Central Pacifying General, and Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hou Tian, palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and minister of works, became grand mentor; Hou Andu, pacifying west general, grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Yuzhou, became minister of works; Wang Chong, palace attendant, central authority general, and grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, became special grand master and left grand master of the palace; Xu Du, guarding north general and inspector of South Xuzhou, became palace attendant, central pacifying general, and grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以侍中、護軍將軍徐世譜為特進、安右將軍；

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Palace Attendant and General Who Protects the Army Xu Shipu became Special Grand Master and General Who Pacifies the Right;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Xu Shipu, palace attendant and general who protects the army, was made special grand master and general who pacifies the right;

sentences.zh: 侍中、忠武將軍杜稜為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and Loyal Martial General Du Ling became General of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Du Ling, palace attendant and loyal martial general, was made general of the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，重雲殿災。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the Hall of Layered Clouds caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Hall of Layered Clouds burned.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，以平北將軍、南徐州刺史留異為安南將軍、縉州刺史，平南將軍、北江州刺史魯悉達進號安左將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guisi, Pacifying North General and Inspector of South Xuzhou Liu Yi became General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jinyang; Pacifying South General and Inspector of North Jiangzhou Lu Sida was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi day, Liu Yi, pacifying north general and inspector of South Xuzhou, became general who pacifies the south and inspector of Jinyang; Lu Sida, pacifying south general and inspector of North Jiangzhou, was promoted to general who pacifies the left.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封皇子伯茂為始興王，[3]奉昭烈王後。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the prince Bomao was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing, Editorial footnote marker 3. to continue the line of Prince Zhao-lie.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the prince Bomao was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing, See editorial note 3. as heir to Prince Zhao-lie.

sentences.zh: 徙封始興嗣王頊為安成王。

translations.literal: The heir of Shixing, Prince Xu, was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, heir of Shixing, was transferred to the title Prince of Ancheng.

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 4.
translations.idiomatic: See editorial note 4.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，立皇子伯宗為皇太子，[5]王公以下賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinyou, the prince Bozong was established as crown prince; Editorial footnote marker 5. dukes, marquises, and those below were granted silk cloth in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou day, the prince Bozong was made crown prince; See editorial note 5. princes, nobles, and officials received gifts of silk in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，立妃沈氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the consort of the surname Shen was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Lady Shen was made empress.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙卯，王琳寇大雷，詔遣太尉侯瑱、司空侯安都、儀同徐度率眾以禦之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day yimao, Wang Lin raided Dalei; an edict dispatched Grand Mentor Hou Tian, Minister of Works Hou Andu, and Commissioner with Equal Protocol Xu Du to lead troops against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, Wang Lin attacked Dalei. An edict sent Hou Tian, grand mentor, Hou Andu, minister of works, and Xu Du, commissioner with equal protocol, with armies to meet him.

sentences.zh: 天嘉元年春正月癸丑，詔曰：「朕以寡昧，嗣纂洪業，哀惸在疚，治道弗昭，仰惟前德，幽顯遐暢，恭己不言，庶幾無改。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Tianjia, on the day guichou, an edict said: "We, slight and dim, have succeeded to the great enterprise; the orphaned and alone are in affliction; the way of rule is not yet clear; looking up to former virtue, the hidden and manifest are far extended; reverently holding Ourselves in check and not speaking, We hope there may be no change.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tianjia (560), on guichou day, an edict declared: "We, unworthy and obscure, have inherited the great enterprise. The realm is orphaned and We are in mourning; government is not yet settled. Looking to the virtue of those before Us, We would reach both the seen and unseen; holding Ourself in reverent silence, We hope for steady rule.

sentences.zh: 雖宏圖懋軌，日月方弘，而清廟廓然，聖靈浸遠，感尋永往，瞻言罔極。

translations.literal: Though the great plan and splendid track, sun and moon are just now broadening, yet the clear temple stands empty and the sage spirit grows ever distant; moved to follow what is forever gone, gazing in speech We find no limit.
translations.idiomatic: Though Our great design spreads wide as sun and moon, the ancestral temple stands empty and the sage spirit recedes. Following thought to what is gone forever, We look up and find no end to grief.

sentences.zh: 今四象運周，三元告獻，華夷胥洎，玉帛駿奔，思覃遺澤，播之億兆。

translations.literal: Now the four images turn through the cycle, the three origins announce their offering; Chinese and barbarian alike reach the shore; jade and silk gallop in; We think to extend the lingering grace and spread it to the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: Now the seasons turn their round and heaven's gifts are renewed; far peoples and near come to court; tribute pours in. We mean to spread the late emperor's bounty to the hundred millions.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty is proclaimed for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 改永定四年為天嘉元年。

translations.literal: The fourth year of Yongding is changed to the first year of Tianjia.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of Yongding is renamed the first year of Tianjia.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存立者，賜穀人五斛。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves shall be given five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the destitute who cannot support themselves shall receive five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田殊行異等，加爵一級。

translations.literal: Those filial, dutiful, and diligent in farming of exceptional conduct and special merit shall receive one additional rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Men outstanding in filial piety, farming, or singular virtue shall receive one further step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，分遣使者宣勞四方。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin envoys were separately dispatched to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were sent out to announce Our goodwill to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，輿駕親祠南郊，詔曰：「朕式饗上玄，虔奉牲玉，高禋禮畢，誠敬兼弘。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb; an edict said: "We perform the offering to the Supreme Lord above, reverently present the victim and jade; when the great suburban rite is complete, sincerity and respect are alike broadened.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the emperor sacrificed in person at the Southern Suburb. An edict said: "We have offered to the Supreme Lord above and reverently presented victims and jade; the great suburban rite is complete, and devotion fills Our heart.

sentences.zh: 且陰霾浹辰，褰霽在日，雲物韶朗，風景清和，慶動人祇，忭流庶俗，[6]思俾黎元，同此多祐。

translations.literal: Moreover, yin gloom had drenched the days, yet the canopy cleared on this day; clouds and things were bright and clear, wind and scenery pure and harmonious; rejoicing moved human spirits and gladness flowed among the people; Editorial footnote marker 6. We think to make the black-haired people share this abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Though gloom had hung for many days, the sky cleared today; clouds shone fair and the air was mild; joy touched heaven and earth and gladness ran among the people. See editorial note 6. We would have the common folk share this blessing.

sentences.zh: 可賜民爵一級。

translations.literal: The people may be granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Let the people receive one step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，輿駕親祠北郊。

translations.literal: " On the day xinwei the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinwei day the emperor sacrificed in person at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 日有冠。

translations.literal: The sun wore a crown.
translations.idiomatic: A solar corona appeared.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinmao, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinmao day, the Old Man star was seen.

sentences.zh: 乙未，高州刺史紀機自軍叛還宣城，據郡以應王琳，涇令賀當遷討平之。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Inspector of Gaozhou Ji Ji rebelled from the army and returned to Xuancheng, holding the commandery in response to Wang Lin; Jing Magistrate He Dangqian campaigned and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Ji Ji, inspector of Gaozhou, deserted his command, returned to Xuancheng, and held the commandery for Wang Lin. He Dangqian, magistrate of Jing, marched against him and restored order.

sentences.zh: 景申，太尉侯瑱敗王琳于梁山，敗齊兵于博望，生摛齊將劉伯球，盡收其資儲船艦，俘馘以萬計，王琳及其主蕭莊奔于齊。

translations.literal: On the day shen of the cycle, Grand Mentor Hou Tian defeated Wang Lin at Liangshan and defeated Qi troops at Bowang; he captured alive the Qi general Liu Boqiu, took all their stores and ships, captives and severed ears numbered in the tens of thousands; Wang Lin and his lord Xiao Zhuang fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On shen day Grand Mentor Hou Tian routed Wang Lin at Liangshan and crushed Northern Qi forces at Bowang. He took the Qi general Liu Boqiu alive, seized their stores and fleet, and counted captives and heads by the ten thousand. Wang Lin and his puppet ruler Xiao Zhuang fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「夫五運遞來，三靈眷命，皇王因之改創，殷、周所以樂推。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu an edict said: "The five fortunes come in turn, the three numina bestow mandate; emperors and kings thereby change and create; Yin and Zhou therefore took joy in pushing him forward.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict declared: "The five fortunes succeed one another and the three spirits grant the mandate; thus emperors and kings renew the realm, as Yin and Zhou once gladly raised their chosen men.

sentences.zh: 朕統曆承基，丕隆鼎運，期理攸屬，數祚斯在，豈僥倖所至，寧卜祝可求。

translations.literal: We have inherited the calendar and received the foundation, greatly elevated the tripod's fortune; the term of rule is where it belongs, the span of blessing is here; how could it be reached by chance? Surely the tortoise and prayer could not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: We have taken the calendar and received the foundation, exalted the dynasty's fortune; the age of rule is Ours by right, the blessing of years rests here—not by chance, nor by divination alone.

sentences.zh: 故知神器之重，必在符命。

translations.literal: Thus one knows the weight of the sacred vessel must lie in the talisman and mandate.
translations.idiomatic: So one knows the throne's weight lies in heaven's sign and mandate.

sentences.zh: 是以逐鹿貽譏，斷蛇定業，亂臣賊子，異世同尤。

translations.literal: Therefore chasing the deer brought reproach, cutting the snake fixed the enterprise; rebellious ministers and wicked sons share the same fault across ages.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the chase for the deer drew blame, while the cut serpent secured the realm; traitors and rebels wear the same guilt in every age.

sentences.zh: 王琳識暗挈瓶，智慚衛足，干紀亂常，自貽顛沛，而縉紳君子，多被縶維，雖涇渭合流，蘭鮑同肆，求之厥理，或有脅從。

translations.literal: Wang Lin's knowledge was dim in holding the bottle, his wisdom ashamed before guarding the foot; he violated the norm and disturbed order, bringing downfall on himself; yet many gentlemen of the gentry were bound and held; though the Jing and Wei mingled their waters and orchid and leek lay in the same market, seeking the principle thereof, some may have followed under compulsion.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin knew too little to hold his charge and lacked wit enough to save himself; he broke the laws and brought ruin on his own head. Yet many gentry were taken bound with him; though the guilty and the innocent were heaped together, some surely followed under duress.

sentences.zh: 今九罭既設，八紘斯掩，天網恢恢，吞舟是漏。

translations.literal: Now the nine nets are set, the eight cords drawn shut; heaven's net is vast and wide, yet the great fish may slip through.
translations.idiomatic: Now the nets are spread and the eight directions closed in; heaven's net is wide, yet even great offenders may pass through its meshes.

sentences.zh: 至如伏波遊說，永作漢蕃，延壽脫歸，終為魏守，器改秦、虞，材通晉、楚，行藏用捨，亦豈有恆，宜加寬仁，以彰雷作。

translations.literal: As for Fubo roaming in persuasion, forever becoming Han's frontier guard; Shou forever escaping and returning, in the end becoming Wei's border warden—the vessel changed with Qin and Yu, talent passed between Jin and Chu; going, staying, using, and discarding—how could they be constant? We should add broad kindness to display thunder's work.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuan once wandered as envoy and became a frontier guard of Han; Cai Yong fled home and ended a warden of Wei—men change with the times, talent flows between states; who stays or goes is not fixed forever. Let Us show the mercy of thunder's season.

sentences.zh: 其衣冠士族，預在凶黨，悉皆原宥；

translations.literal: Gentry and clans who beforehand were in the wicked faction are all pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: Gentry and clans who joined the rebel faction are all forgiven;

sentences.zh: 將帥戰兵，亦同肆眚，[7]並隨才銓引，庶收力用。

translations.literal: generals and fighting troops are likewise pardoned in the same amnesty; Editorial footnote marker 7. and according to talent they shall be appointed and led forth, that We may gather their use.
translations.idiomatic: commanders and common soldiers share the same pardon; See editorial note 7. let them be placed by merit, that We may put their strength to use.

sentences.zh: 」又詔師旅以來，將士死王事者，並加贈謚。

translations.literal: " Another edict: since the armies marched, officers and soldiers who died for the royal affair shall all receive posthumous enfeoffment and posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: " A further edict: all officers and soldiers who died in the royal service since the campaigns began shall receive posthumous honors and titles.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔曰：「日者凶渠肆虐，眾軍進討，舟艦輸積，權倩民丁，師出經時，役勞日久。

translations.literal: On the day jihai an edict said: "Recently the wicked chieftain ran riot; the armies advanced in punishment; ships and transports piled up; corvée and labor were borrowed from the people; the armies were out for a long time and service and toil lasted many days.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict declared: "Lately the rebel chief ravaged the land; Our armies marched to punish him. Ships and supplies piled high; the people were pressed for labor; the hosts were long in the field and toil ran on for months.

sentences.zh: 今氣祲廓清，宜有甄被。

translations.literal: Now the evil vapors are cleared and the realm made pure; there should be discrimination and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Now the omens of disorder have cleared; let mercy sort the harmed from the guilty.

sentences.zh: 可蠲復丁身。

translations.literal: Corvée service and personal levies may be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée drafts and personal levies are remitted.

sentences.zh: 夫妻三年，於役不幸者，復其妻子。

translations.literal: Husbands and wives of three years' standing, if one died in service by misfortune, their wives and children shall be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Where husband and wife had been wed three years and one died on campaign, the survivor and children shall be released from obligation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，分遣使者賷璽書宣勞四方。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi envoys were separately dispatched bearing the imperial seal and writings to proclaim comfort to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day envoys were sent bearing the imperial seal and edicts to announce Our goodwill to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣太尉侯瑱鎮湓城。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Grand Mentor Hou Tian was sent to guard Pen City.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Grand Mentor Hou Tian was sent to hold Pen City.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以高祖第六子昌為驃騎將軍、湘州牧，立為衡陽王。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the Founder's sixth son Chang was made Rapid Tiger General and Governor of Xiangzhou and established as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Chang, the Founder's sixth son, was made Rapid Tiger General and governor of Xiangzhou and enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 三月景辰，詔曰：「自喪亂以來，十有餘載，編戶凋亡，萬不遺一，中原氓庶，蓋云無幾。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day chen of the cycle, an edict said: "Since disorder and ruin, more than ten years have passed; registered households have withered away, not one in ten thousand remains; the common people of the central plains can scarcely be said to exist.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on chen day, an edict declared: "Since rebellion and ruin more than ten years have passed. Registered households have dwindled until scarcely one in ten thousand remains; the people of the heartland can hardly be said to survive.

sentences.zh: 頃者寇難仍接，筭斂繁多，且興師已來，千金日費，府藏虛竭，杼軸歲空。

translations.literal: Recently bandit troubles have come in succession and reckonings and levies have been numerous; moreover, since the armies were raised, a thousand gold is spent each day; the treasury is emptied and the loom's shuttle wears thin year by year.
translations.idiomatic: Lately raids have followed raids and taxes have multiplied; since war began a thousand gold flows out each day. The treasury stands empty and every household is scraped bare.

sentences.zh: 近所置軍資，本充戎備，今元惡克殄，八表已康，兵戈靜戢，息肩方在，思俾餘黎，陶此寬賦，今歲軍糧通減三分之一。

translations.literal: The military grain lately set aside was originally to fill war stores; now the chief villain is destroyed and the eight regions are already at peace; arms are stilled and shoulders may rest; We think to make the remaining people receive this broad tax relief; this year's military grain shall be reduced by one third throughout.
translations.idiomatic: The grain lately levied for the armies was meant for war stores; now the arch-rebel is dead and the realm is calm, weapons are laid by and the people may breathe. We would ease the burden on those who remain: this year's military grain levy is cut by one third.

sentences.zh: 尚書申下四方，稱朕哀矜之意。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing shall send down to the four quarters, voicing Our compassionate intent.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall proclaim this mercy to every province.

sentences.zh: 守宰明加勸課，務急農桑，庶鼓腹含哺，復在茲日。

translations.literal: Local administrators shall clearly urge farming and mulberry; let bellies be drummed full and mouths nursed in peace—may that day return soon.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates must urge plowing and sericulture with all their power, that men may once more drum their full bellies and nurse their children in peace.

sentences.zh: 」蕭莊所署郢州刺史孫瑒舉州內附。

translations.literal: " Sun Yang, whom Xiao Zhuang had appointed Inspector of Yingzhou, led the whole commandery to submit.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun Yang, whom Xiao Zhuang had named inspector of Yingzhou, brought the entire commandery over to Our side.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，江州刺史周迪平南中，斬賊率熊曇朗，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Inspector of Jiangzhou Zhou Di pacified the southern center, beheaded the bandit leader Xiong Tanlang, and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Zhou Di, inspector of Jiangzhou, pacified the southern center, slew the rebel chief Xiong Tanlang, and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是，齊軍守魯山城，戊午，齊軍棄城走，詔南豫州刺史程靈洗守之。

translations.literal: Earlier Northern Qi troops had held Lushan city; on the day wuwu the Qi army abandoned the city and fled; an edict ordered Inspector of South Yuzhou Cheng Lingxiu to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi had held Lushan city; on wuwu day the Qi garrison abandoned it and fled. An edict put Cheng Lingxiu, inspector of South Yuzhou, in charge of the place.

sentences.zh: 甲子，分荊州之天門、義陽、南平，郢州之武陵四郡，置武州。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the four commanderies of Tianmen, Yiyang, and Nanping from Jingzhou and Wuling from Yingzhou were separated out to establish Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Tianmen, Yiyang, and Nanping were taken from Jingzhou and Wuling from Yingzhou to form the new province of Wu.

sentences.zh: 其刺史督沅州，領武陵太守，治武陵郡。

translations.literal: Its inspector supervised Yuan Province, concurrently held the post of Administrator of Wuling, and administered Wuling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Its inspector oversaw Yuan Province, served concurrently as administrator of Wuling, and governed from Wuling commandery.

sentences.zh: 其都尉所部六縣為沅州。

translations.literal: The six counties under its commandant's jurisdiction constituted Yuan Province.
translations.idiomatic: The six counties under the commandant's authority were organized as Yuan Province.

sentences.zh: 別置通寧郡，以刺史領太守，治都尉城，省舊都尉。

translations.literal: Tongning commandery was separately established; the inspector concurrently held the administrator's post, administering from the commandant's walled city, and the former commandant post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tongning commandery was set up separately; the inspector also served as its administrator, with his seat at the commandant's fortress, and the old commandant office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以安南將軍、南兗州刺史、新除右衛將軍吳明徹為安西將軍、武州刺史，偽郢州刺史孫瑒為安南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: Wu Mingche, General Who Pacifies the South, Inspector of South Yanzhou, and newly appointed Right Palace Guard General, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Wu Prefecture; Sun Rang, the pretender Xiao Zhuang's Inspector of Yingzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the south, inspector of South Yanzhou, and newly appointed right palace guard general, was made general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu prefecture; Sun Rang, whom the pretender Xiao Zhuang had named inspector of Yingzhou, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 景子，衡陽王昌薨。

translations.literal: On jingzi day the Prince of Hengyang, Chang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jingzi day the Prince of Hengyang, Chang, died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔曰：「蕭莊偽署文武官屬還朝者，量加錄序。」

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict said: "As for civil and military officials whom Xiao Zhuang had falsely appointed who return to court, each is to be enrolled and ranked according to merit."
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict declared: "Civil and military officers who served in Xiao Zhuang's false regime and now return to court are to be registered and promoted according to their merits."

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，立皇子伯信為衡陽王，奉獻王後。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on dinghai day, the imperial son Boxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang to continue the line of the late prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dinghai day, the imperial son Boxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang to continue the line of the late prince.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以安南將軍荀朗為安北將軍、合州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Xun Lang, General Who Pacifies the South, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of He Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Xun Lang, general who pacifies the south, was made general who pacifies the north and inspector of He province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，改桂陽之汝城縣為盧陽郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Rucheng county in Guiyang was made Luyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, Rucheng county in Guiyang was elevated to Luyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 分衡州之始興、安遠二郡，置東衡州。

translations.literal: The two commanderies of Shixing and Anyuan in Hengzhou were split off to establish East Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Shixing and Anyuan in Hengzhou were detached to form East Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，改謚皇祖妣景安皇后曰景文皇后。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, the posthumous title of the Founder's grandmother, Empress Jing'an, was changed to Empress Jingwen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, the posthumous title of the Founder's grandmother, Empress Jing'an, was changed to Empress Jingwen.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔曰：「梁孝元遭離多難，靈櫬播越，朕昔經北面，有異常倫，遣使迎接，以次近路。

translations.literal: On renchen day an edict said: "Emperor Xiaoyuan of Liang suffered many calamities; his coffin was carried far abroad. We once faced north toward him in a bond outside the usual order and sent envoys to meet him by the nearest route.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict declared: "Emperor Xiaoyuan of Liang endured grievous trials, and his coffin was borne far from home. We once faced north toward him in a bond beyond ordinary measure and sent envoys to receive him by the shortest route.

sentences.zh: 江寧既是舊塋，[8]宜即安卜，車旗禮章，悉用梁典，依魏葬漢獻帝故事。

translations.literal: Since Jiangning is the old burial ground, [8] it is fitting to fix the tomb site at once; carriage banners and ritual regalia shall all follow Liang precedent, after the story of Wei burying Emperor Xian of Han."
translations.idiomatic: Since Jiangning is the ancestral burial ground, [8] the tomb should be fixed there at once; carriage banners and ritual regalia shall follow Liang precedent, on the model of Wei burying Emperor Xian of Han."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，追策故始興昭烈王妃曰孝妃。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the late consort of Zhaolie, Prince of Shixing, the Founder's mother, was posthumously invested as Imperial Consort Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Founder's mother, the late consort of Zhaolie, Prince of Shixing, was posthumously honored as Imperial Consort Xiao.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以開府儀同三司徐度為侍中、中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Xu Du, Champion of the State with Honours Equal to the Three Dukes, was made Palace Attendant and Central Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xu Du, champion of the state with honours equal to the three dukes, was made palace attendant and central army general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，國哀周忌，上臨于太極前殿，百僚陪哭。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, when the year's mourning observance for the state lapsed, the Emperor went in person to the front hall of the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; the hundred officials accompanied him in weeping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, when the year's mourning for the state was complete, the emperor went in person to the front hall of the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate, and the hundred officials joined him in mourning.

sentences.zh: 赦京師殊死已下。

translations.literal: Amnesty within the capital for capital offenses and below.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed in the capital for capital crimes and below.

sentences.zh: 是月，葬梁元帝於江寧。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Yuan of Liang was buried at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Yuan of Liang was buried at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，詔曰：「朕以眇身，屬當大寶，負荷至重，憂責實深，而庶績未康，胥怨猶結，佇咨賢良，發於夢想，每有一言入聽，片善可求，何嘗不褒獎抽揚，緘書紳帶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiayin day, an edict said: "We, with Our slight person, have received the great treasure; the burden borne is utmost and anxiety and responsibility truly deep—yet the myriad tasks are not at peace and mutual resentment still knots. We look to worthy men as in a dream; whenever one word enters Our hearing or a scrap of goodness can be sought, how have We ever failed to praise, draw forth, and bind to Our girdle?
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiayin day, an edict declared: "We, unworthy as We are, have received the great mandate; the burden is heavy and Our anxiety deep—yet the realm is not at peace and grievances still fester. We long for the worthy as in a dream; whenever a word of counsel reaches Us or the least merit appears, how have We failed to praise it, draw it forth, and bind it to Our sash?

sentences.zh: 而傅巖虛往，穹谷尚淹，蒲幣空陳，旌弓不至。

translations.literal: Yet the rock of Fuyue stands empty and deep valleys still lie submerged; rush silks are offered in vain and the signal bow does not come.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the rock of Fuyue stands empty and deep valleys remain unvisited; offerings of rush are laid out in vain and the signal bow is never bent.

sentences.zh: 豈當有乖則哲，使草澤遺才？

translations.literal: Is it that We fall short of the wise who choose men, and that talent in the grass and marshes is lost?
translations.idiomatic: Is it that We fall short of the sage who chooses men, and that talent in the wilds is lost?

sentences.zh: 將時運澆流，今不逮古？

translations.literal: Or that the times run muddy and the present cannot match antiquity?
translations.idiomatic: Or that the age runs foul and the present cannot equal antiquity?

sentences.zh: 側食長懷，寢興增歎。

translations.literal: We eat on one side and ever cherish the thought; rising and lying down We only sigh the more.
translations.idiomatic: We take Our meals on one side and brood without cease; waking and sleeping We sigh all the more.

sentences.zh: 新安太守陸山才有啟，薦梁前征西從事中郎蕭策，梁前尚書中兵郎王暹，並世冑清華，羽儀著族，或文史足用，或孝德可稱，並宜登之朝序，擢以不次。

translations.literal: Lu Shan Talent, Administrator of Xin'an, submitted a memorial recommending Xiao Ce, former aide-de-camp on the western campaign of Liang, and Wang Xun, former director of centre in the Ministry of War of Liang—both of pure lineage from noble houses, standards of their clans; one sufficient in letters and histories, the other in filial virtue fit for praise—each is to be raised in court order and promoted out of turn.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shan Talent, administrator of Xin'an, memorialized recommending Xiao Ce, former aide on Liang's western campaign staff, and Wang Xun, former director in the Ministry of War of Liang—both of eminent lineage and shining houses; one adequate in letters and histories, the other in filial virtue worthy of praise—and asked that each be raised in court rank and promoted out of turn.

sentences.zh: 王公已下，其各進舉賢良，申薦淪屈，庶眾才必萃，大廈可成，使棫樸載哥，[9]由庚在詠。

translations.literal: From kings and dukes down, each is to advance recommendations of worthy men and report those wronged and submerged, so that the multitude of talents may surely gather, the great hall may be raised, and the poems of Zhi Pu and You Geng may again be sung (see editorial note 9).
translations.idiomatic: From kings and dukes downward, each is to recommend worthy men and report those wronged and overlooked, so that talents may gather, the great hall be built, and the songs of Zhi Pu and You Geng be sung once more (see editorial note 9).

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，詔曰：「自頃喪亂，編戶播遷，言念餘黎，良可哀惕。

translations.literal: On yimao day an edict said: "Since the recent disorders households have scattered; thinking of the remaining people, We are truly moved to pity.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict declared: "Since the recent disorders households have been uprooted; thinking of the people who remain, We are deeply moved to pity.

sentences.zh: 其亡鄉失土，逐食流移者，今年內隨其適樂，來歲不問僑舊，悉令著籍，同土斷之例。

translations.literal: Those who have lost their native districts and land and drift seeking food—in this year let them settle where they find comfort; next year, without distinguishing native from refugee, all are to be registered on the rolls, following the precedent of unified territorial registration."
translations.idiomatic: Those who have lost their native places and wander seeking livelihood may this year settle where they find ease; next year, without distinguishing old residents from newcomers, all shall be entered on the registers, following the precedent of unified territorial registration."

sentences.zh: 」景辰，立皇子伯山為鄱陽王。

translations.literal: On jingchen day the imperial son Boshan was enfeoffed as Prince of Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jingchen day the imperial son Boshan was enfeoffed as Prince of Poyang.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，老人星見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen day, the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen day, the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「菽粟之貴，重於珠玉。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict said: "The worth of beans and millet is heavier than pearls and jade.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict declared: "The worth of grain is greater than pearls and jade.

sentences.zh: 自頃寇戎，游手者眾，民失分地之業，士有佩犢之譏。

translations.literal: Since the recent campaigns idlers have been many; the people have lost the industry of allotted fields, and gentlemen bear the mockery of wearing oxen at their belts.
translations.idiomatic: Since the recent wars idlers have multiplied; the people have lost their allotted fields, and gentlemen are mocked for wearing oxen at their belts.

sentences.zh: 朕哀矜黔庶，念康弊俗，思俾阻饑，方存富教。

translations.literal: We pity the black-haired people and wish to heal a ruined custom, thinking to rescue those blocked by hunger and yet to enrich through teaching.
translations.idiomatic: We pity the common people and wish to heal a ruined way of life, seeking to relieve hunger and yet to enrich them through instruction.

sentences.zh: 麥之為用，要切斯甚，今九秋在節，萬實可收，其班宣遠近，並令播種。

translations.literal: The use of wheat is urgently needful—now the ninth month is at hand and the myriad harvests can be gathered; proclaim this far and near and all are to sow.
translations.idiomatic: Wheat is urgently needed—now the ninth month is at hand and the myriad crops can be gathered; proclaim this far and near and order all to sow.

sentences.zh: 守宰親臨勸課，務使及時。

translations.literal: Governors and prefects are to come in person to urge the season's work and see that it is done in time.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and prefects are to go in person to urge the season's work and see that it is done in time.

sentences.zh: 其有尤貧，量給種子。

translations.literal: Where there is extreme poverty, distribute seed according to measure."
translations.idiomatic: Where households are utterly destitute, seed is to be distributed according to need."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，世祖臨景陽殿聽訟。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the Founding Emperor held court at Jingyang Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Emperor Wen heard cases in person at Jingyang Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「汙樽土鼓，誠則難追，畫卵彫薪，或可易革。

translations.literal: On wuzi day an edict said: "The muddy goblet and earthen drum—sincerity is hard to recover; painted eggs and carved kindling—or perhaps they can be changed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict declared: "The muddy goblet and earthen drum—such sincerity is hard to recover; painted eggs and carved firewood—or perhaps they can be changed.

sentences.zh: 梁氏末運，奢麗已甚，芻豢厭於胥史，哥鍾列於管庫，土木被朱丹之采，車馬飾金玉之珍，逐欲澆流，遷訛遂遠。

translations.literal: In Liang's last fortune luxury had grown extreme; meat feasts sated petty clerks, singing bells lined the storehouses, earth and timber bore cinnabar hues, carriages and horses were adorned with gold and jade treasures—following desire the stream ran ever more polluted and error drifted far.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang's last days luxury had grown extreme: meat feasts sated petty clerks, singing bells filled the storehouses, buildings were painted cinnabar, carriages and horses were adorned with gold and jade—desire ran like a muddy stream and error drifted ever farther.

sentences.zh: 朕自諸生，頗為內足，而家敦朴素，室靡浮華，觀覽時俗，常所扼腕。

translations.literal: We, from student years, have found inward sufficiency, yet the family has cultivated plainness and the chambers have been free of ostentation; viewing the fashion of the times We have often wrung Our hands.
translations.idiomatic: We, from Our student years, have been inwardly content, yet Our house has cultivated plainness and Our chambers have been free of display; viewing the fashion of the age We have often wrung Our hands.

sentences.zh: 今妄假時乘，臨馭區極，屬當淪季，思聞治道，菲食卑宮，自安儉陋，俾茲薄俗，獲反淳風。

translations.literal: Now, falsely riding the timely chance and facing the utmost pole of the realm, as We stand in a fallen age We wish to hear the way of good order; plain food and low palace, resting content in thrift and simplicity, to make this shallow custom recover pure wind.
translations.idiomatic: Now, having falsely seized the timely moment and come to face the realm's summit, as We stand in a fallen age We wish to hear the way of good order: plain food and humble palace, content in thrift and simplicity, that this shallow custom may return to pure wind.

sentences.zh: 維雕鏤淫飾，非兵器及國容所須，金銀珠玉，衣服雜玩，悉皆禁斷。

translations.literal: Carved decoration and licentious ornament—not those arms or utensils the state rites require—gold, silver, pearls, jade, garments and assorted playthings: all alike are forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Carved ornament and licentious display—not arms or utensils required for state ritual—gold, silver, pearls, jade, garments, and assorted luxuries: all alike are forbidden."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，周將賀若敦率馬步一萬，奄至武陵，武州刺史吳明徹不能拒，引軍還巴陵。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Zhou General He Ruodun led ten thousand horse and foot, suddenly reaching Wuling; Wu Prefecture Inspector Wu Mingche could not resist and led the army back to Baling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Zhou general He Ruodun led ten thousand horse and foot and suddenly reached Wuling; Wu Mingche, inspector of Wu prefecture, could not hold him and withdrew to Baling.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上幸正陽堂閱武。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the Emperor visited Zhengyang Hall to review arms.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the emperor reviewed troops at Zhengyang Hall.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，彗星見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou day, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou day, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，周將獨孤盛領水軍將趣巴、湘，與賀若敦水陸俱進，太尉侯瑱自尋陽往禦之。

translations.literal: On yimao day Zhou General Dugu Sheng led the navy intending Ba and Xiang; with He Ruodun advancing by water and land together, Grand Marshal Hou Tian went from Xunyang to check them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Zhou general Dugu Sheng led the fleet toward Ba and Xiang; with He Ruodun advancing by land and water together, Grand Marshal Hou Tian marched from Xunyang to oppose them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣儀同徐度率眾會瑱于巴丘。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Commissioner-with-Equal-Rank Xu Du was sent leading troops to join Tian at Baqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Xu Du, commissioner with equal rank, was dispatched with troops to join Hou Tian at Baqiu.

sentences.zh: 景子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jingzi day the Great White star appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jingzi day the planet Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔侯瑱眾軍進討巴、湘。

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered Tian and the host of armies to advance and attack Ba and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Hou Tian and the host of armies to advance against Ba and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，侯瑱襲破獨孤盛於楊葉洲，盡獲其船艦，盛收兵登岸，築城以保之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on guisi day, Hou Tian ambushed and broke Dugu Sheng at Yangye islet, capturing all his vessels; Sheng gathered troops ashore and built a walled camp to hold himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi day, Hou Tian ambushed and routed Dugu Sheng at Yangye Islet, seizing all his ships; Sheng gathered his men ashore and built a fortified camp to hold his ground.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔司空侯安都率眾會侯瑱南討。

translations.literal: On dingyou day an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to lead troops to join Tian in the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered Hou Andu, minister of works, to lead troops south to join Hou Tian.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，詔曰：「古者春夏二氣，不決重罪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, an edict said: "In antiquity spring and summer, the two seasons, did not decide capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, an edict declared: "In antiquity the two seasons of spring and summer did not decide capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 蓋以陽和布澤，天秩是弘，寬網眘刑，[10]義符含育，前王所以則天象地，立法垂訓者也。

translations.literal: For yang harmony spreads bounty and Heaven's order is thus broad; a lenient net and wary punishment [10] match fostering nurture—the former kings thereby modeled Heaven and earth and legislated to hand down teaching.
translations.idiomatic: For when yang harmony spreads its bounty Heaven's order is broad; a lenient net and cautious punishment [10] accord with fostering life—the former kings thereby took Heaven and earth as their model and set laws to hand down teaching.

sentences.zh: 朕屬當澆季，思求民瘼，哀矜惻隱，念甚納隍，常欲式遵舊軌，用長風化。

translations.literal: We stand in a fallen age and seek the people's woes; pity and compassion are deep, and Our thought of those drowning is like filling a moat—we ever wish to follow the old tracks to lengthen custom's wind.
translations.idiomatic: We stand in a fallen age and seek the people's afflictions; Our pity is deep, and Our thought of those drowning is like filling a moat—we ever wish to follow the old tracks and lengthen the wind of custom.

sentences.zh: 自今孟春訖于夏首，罪人大辟事已款者，宜且申停。

translations.literal: From now, from the first month of spring until the start of summer, in cases of capital crime already confessed, execution is for the present to be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: From now, from the first month of spring until the start of summer, in capital cases where guilt is already established, execution is for the present to be suspended."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，周巴陵城主尉遲憲降，遣巴州刺史侯安鼎守之。

translations.literal: On jihai day Yuchi Xian, Zhou governor of Baling city, surrendered; Baling Inspector Hou Anding was sent to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Yuchi Xian, Zhou commander of Baling, surrendered; Hou Anding, inspector of Baling, was sent to hold the city.

sentences.zh: [11]庚子，獨孤盛將餘眾自楊葉洲潛遁。

translations.literal: [11] On gengzi day Dugu Sheng with his remaining troops secretly fled from Yangye islet.
translations.idiomatic: [11] On gengzi day Dugu Sheng fled secretly from Yangye Islet with his remaining troops.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以雲麾將軍、晉陵太守杜稜為侍中、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Du Ling, General of Cloudy Pennons and Administrator of Jinling, was made Palace Attendant and Director of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Du Ling, general of cloudy pennons and administrator of Jinling, was made palace attendant and director of the guard.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以始興王伯茂為宣惠將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was made General Who Spreads Favour and Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was made general who spreads favour and inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，合州刺史裴景徽奔于齊。

translations.literal: On yimao day He Province Inspector Pei Jinghui defected to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Pei Jinghui, inspector of He province, defected to Qi.

sentences.zh: [12]辛未，周湘州城主殷亮降，湘州平。

translations.literal: [12] On xinwei day Yin Liang, Zhou governor of Xiangzhou city, surrendered; Xiangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: [12] On xinwei day Yin Liang, Zhou commander of Xiangzhou, surrendered, and Xiangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月景戌，以太尉侯瑱為車騎將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jingxu day, Grand Marshal Hou Tian was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jingxu day, Grand Marshal Hou Tian was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，曲赦湘州諸郡。

translations.literal: On gengyin day a partial amnesty for the commanderies of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day a partial amnesty was granted for the commanderies of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，太尉、車騎將軍、湘州刺史侯瑱薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, Grand Marshal, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Xiangzhou Inspector Hou Tian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao day, Hou Tian, grand marshal, grand general of chariots and cavalry, and inspector of Xiangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，[13]以鎮東將軍、會稽太守徐度為鎮南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingchou day [13] Xu Du, General Who Pacifies the East and Administrator of Kuaiji, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Xiangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day [13] Xu Du, general who pacifies the east and administrator of Kuaiji, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，分荊州之南平、宜都、羅、河東四郡，置南荊州，鎮河東郡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the four commanderies of Nanping, Yidu, Luo, and Hedong in Jingzhou were split off to establish South Jingzhou, administered from Hedong commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the four commanderies of Nanping, Yidu, Luo, and Hedong in Jingzhou were detached to form South Jingzhou, with its seat at Hedong commandery.

sentences.zh: 以安西將軍、武州刺史吳明徹為南荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Wu Mingche, General Who Pacifies the West and Wu Prefecture Inspector, was made South Jingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the west and inspector of Wu prefecture, was made inspector of South Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以安左將軍魯悉達為安南將軍、吳州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Lu Sidao, General Who Pacifies the Left, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Wu Prefecture Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Lu Sidao, general who pacifies the left, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Wu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，老人星見。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 秋七月景午，周將賀若敦自拔遁歸，人畜死者十七八。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jingwu day, Zhou General He Ruodun broke out and fled on his own; men and livestock dead were seven or eight in ten.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jingwu day, the Zhou general He Ruodun broke out and fled on his own; seven or eight in ten of his men and livestock perished.

sentences.zh: 武陵、天門、南平、義陽、河東、宜都郡悉平。

translations.literal: Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu commanderies were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Wuling, Tianmen, Nanping, Yiyang, Hedong, and Yidu were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，詔曰：「姬業方闡，望載渭濱，漢曆既融，道通圮上。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin day, an edict said: "When the House of Ji was opening its work, hopes fixed on the Wei bank; when Han's sequence fused, the Way reached the ruined altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin day, an edict declared: "When the house of Ji was opening its work, hopes fixed on the banks of the Wei; when Han's mandate was fulfilled, the Way reached the ruined altar.

sentences.zh: 若乃摛精辰宿，降靈惟岳，風雲有感，夢寐是求，斯固舟楫鹽梅，遞相表裏，長世建國，罔或不然。

translations.literal: If one gathers essence from the constellations and sends down spirit from the sacred peak, when wind and cloud respond and dreams seek their man—this is indeed the boat and oar, the salt and plum, inward and outward in turn, for long ages founding states—has it ever been otherwise?
translations.idiomatic: When essence is gathered from the constellations and spirit descends from the sacred peak, when wind and cloud respond and dreams seek their man—this is indeed the boat and oar, the salt and plum, inner and outer in turn, for founding states through long ages—has it ever been otherwise?

sentences.zh: 至於銘德太常，從祀清廟，以貽厥後來，垂諸不朽者也。

translations.literal: And when merit is inscribed in the Grand Steward and they follow sacrifice in the clear temple, to leave it to those who come after and hang it in imperishable record.
translations.idiomatic: And when merit is inscribed in the Grand Steward and they share sacrifice in the clear temple, to leave it to those who come after and hang it in imperishable record.

sentences.zh: 前皇經濟區宇，裁成品物，靈貺式甄，光膺寶命，雖謩明濬發，幽顯協從，亦文武賢能，翼宣王業。

translations.literal: The former emperor regulated the realm and completed the shaping of things; numinous favour was bestowed and the treasured mandate brightly received—though sagely brilliance burst forth and hidden and manifest alike followed, still civil and military worthies aided and spread the royal enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: The former emperor regulated the realm and completed the shaping of things; numinous favour was bestowed and the treasured mandate brightly received—though sagely brilliance shone forth and hidden and manifest alike followed, still civil and military worthies aided and spread the royal enterprise.

sentences.zh: 故大司馬、驃騎大將軍瑱，故司空文育，故平北將軍、開府儀同三司僧明，故中護軍穎，故領軍將軍擬，或締構艱難，經綸夷險；

translations.literal: Thus Grand Marshal and General-in-Chief Tian, thus Minister of Works Wenyu, thus General Who Pacifies the North and Champion with Honours Sengming, thus Central Army Commander Ying, thus Director of the Guard Ni—or framed structure in hardship and steered policy through peril;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the late Grand Marshal and general-in-chief Hou Tian, the late Minister of Works Zhou Wenyu, the late general who pacifies the north and champion with honours Zhou Sengming, the late central army commander Hu Ying, and the late director of the guard Chen Ni—some framed the structure in hardship and steered policy through peril;

sentences.zh: 或摧鋒冒刃，殉義遺生；

translations.literal: some dashed the vanguard and braved the blade, dying for righteousness and leaving their lives;
translations.idiomatic: some dashed the vanguard and braved the blade, dying for righteousness and leaving their lives;

sentences.zh: 或宣哲協規，綢繆帷幄；

translations.literal: some with bright wisdom joined counsel and bound the inner strategy;
translations.idiomatic: some with bright wisdom joined counsel and bound the inner strategy;

sentences.zh: 或披荊汗馬，終始勤劬；

translations.literal: some cleared thorns and sweated for the horse, diligent from first to last;
translations.idiomatic: some cleared thorns and sweated for the horse, diligent from first to last;

sentences.zh: 莫不罄誠悉力，屯泰以之。

translations.literal: none failed to exhaust loyalty and strength, and by them security was established.
translations.idiomatic: none failed to exhaust loyalty and strength, and by them security was established.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡昧，嗣膺丕緒，永言勳烈，思弘典訓，便可式遵故實，載揚盛軌，可並配食高祖廟庭，俾茲大猷，永傳宗祏。

translations.literal: We, dim and few, have succeeded to the great line; ever speaking of their achievements We wish to enlarge the canon: let the former substance be followed, the grand track be raised—they may all share sacrifice in the High Ancestor's temple court, that this great design may ever pass through the ancestral tablets."
translations.idiomatic: We, dim and few, have succeeded to the great line; ever mindful of their achievements We wish to enlarge the canon: let the former precedent be followed and the grand track be raised—they may all share sacrifice in the High Ancestor's temple court, that this great design may ever pass through the ancestral tablets."

sentences.zh: 」景辰，以侍中、中權將軍、特進、左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王沖為丹陽尹；

translations.literal: On jingchen day Wang Chong, Palace Attendant, Central Authority General, Special Grandee, Left Grandee of the Imperial Household, and Champion with Honours, was made Intendant of Danyang;
translations.idiomatic: On jingchen day Wang Chong, palace attendant, central authority general, special grandee, left grandee of the imperial household, and champion with honours, was made intendant of Danyang;

sentences.zh: 丹陽尹沈君理為左民尚書，領步兵校尉。

translations.literal: Shen Junli, Intendant of Danyang, was made Director of the Left in the Ministry of the People and concurrently Commandant of Footsoldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Junli, intendant of Danyang, was made director of the left in the Ministry of the People and concurrently commandant of footsoldiers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，[14]霍州西山蠻率部落內屬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, [14] the Western Mountain barbarians of Huo Prefecture led their tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi day, [14] the Western Mountain tribes of Huo Prefecture led their clans to submit.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，高驪國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以武昌、國川為竟陵郡，以安流民。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Wuchang and Guochuan were made Jingling commandery to settle wandering people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wuchang and Guochuan were formed into Jingling commandery to settle displaced people.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，以安東將軍、吳郡太守孫瑒為中護軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinsi day, Sun Rang, General Who Pacifies the East and Administrator of Wu commandery, was made Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi day, Sun Rang, general who pacifies the east and administrator of Wu commandery, was made central army commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，立始興國廟於京師，用王者之禮。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the temple of the state of Shixing was established in the capital, using the rites of a king.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the ancestral temple of the state of Shixing was established in the capital with the rites due a king.

sentences.zh: 太子中庶子虞荔、御史中丞孔奐以國用不足，奏立煮海鹽賦及榷酤之科，詔並施行。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Attendant Yu Li and Imperial Censor-in-Chief Kong Huan, because state revenue was insufficient, memorialized to establish levies on boiling sea salt and monopolies on wine, and an edict ordered both measures carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Li, attendant to the crown prince, and Kong Huan, imperial censor-in-chief, because state revenue was insufficient, memorialized to establish levies on sea-salt boiling and wine monopolies; an edict ordered both measures carried out.

sentences.zh: 先是，縉州刺史留異應于王琳等反，景戌，詔司空侯安都率眾討之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shixin Inspector Liu Yi had responded to Wang Lin and others in rebellion; on jingxu day an edict ordered Minister of Works Hou Andu to lead troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Yi, inspector of Shixin, had joined Wang Lin's rebellion; on jingxu day an edict ordered Hou Andu, minister of works, to lead troops against him.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚戌，設帷宮於南郊，幣告胡公以配天。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a ritual canopy was set up at the Southern Suburb and silks were offered to Lord Hu to accompany Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, a ritual canopy was set up at the Southern Suburb and silks were offered to Lord Hu as companion to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，輿駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕負荷寶圖，亟回星琯，兢兢業業，庶幾治定，而德化不孚，俗弊滋甚，永言念之，無忘日夜。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We bear the treasured chart, the stars turn again and again, diligent and fearful, We hope for order settled—yet virtue does not reach the people and custom's ills grow worse; ever speaking of it We cannot forget day or night.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "We bear the imperial chart; the stars turn again and again; diligent and fearful, We hope for settled order—yet Our virtue has not won the people and custom's ills grow worse; speaking of it We cannot forget it day or night.

sentences.zh: 陽和布氣，昭事上玄，躬奉牲玉，誠兼饗敬，思與黎元被斯寬惠。

translations.literal: Yang harmony spreads its breath; the bright service is to the Supreme; We personally offer victims and jade, sincerity joined with reverent offering, thinking to make the black-haired people share this broad bounty.
translations.idiomatic: When yang harmony spreads its breath We brightly serve the Supreme; We personally offer victims and jade in sincerity and reverent offering, thinking to share this broad bounty with the people.

sentences.zh: 可普賜民爵一級。

translations.literal: A general grant of noble rank of one degree to the people may be made.
translations.idiomatic: A general grant of noble rank of one degree may be made to the people.

sentences.zh: 其孝悌力田，別加一等。

translations.literal: Those filial, brotherly, and diligent in farming receive an additional degree.
translations.idiomatic: Those noted for filial piety, brotherliness, and diligence in farming receive an additional degree.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，輿駕親祠北郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the emperor personally sacrificed at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 閏二月己酉，以百濟王餘明為撫東大將軍，高句驪王高湯[15]為寧東將軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month, on jiyou day, Yu Ming, King of Baekje, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East, and Gao Tang [15], King of Goguryeo, was made General Who Tranquilizes the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on jiyou day, Yu Ming, king of Baekje, was made grand general who pacifies the east, and Gao Tang [15], king of Goguryeo, was made general who tranquilizes the east.

sentences.zh: 江州刺史周迪舉兵應留異，襲湓城，攻豫章郡，並不剋。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou Inspector Zhou Di raised troops in response to Liu Yi, attacked Pencheng, and assaulted Yuzhang commandery, but did not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Di, inspector of Jiangzhou, raised troops in support of Liu Yi, attacked Pencheng, and assaulted Yuzhang commandery, but could not take them.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以南荊州刺史吳明徹為安右將軍。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Wu Mingche, Inspector of South Jingzhou, was made General Who Pacifies the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wu Mingche, inspector of South Jingzhou, was made general who pacifies the right.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改鑄五銖錢。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the five-zhu coins were recast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court recast five-zhu coin.

sentences.zh: 三月景子，安成王頊至自周，詔授侍中、中書監、中衛將軍，置佐史。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jingzi day, the King of Ancheng, Xu, arrived from Zhou; an edict appointed him Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and Central Guard General, and set up aides and clerks.
